appointments_calendar_id_check.name: appointments_calendar_id_check
appointments_calendar_id_check.value: "appointments"."calendar_id" is null or (char_length("appointments"."calendar_id") between 1 and 255 and "appointments"."calendar_id" !~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]')

audit_log_actor_shape.name: audit_log_actor_shape
audit_log_actor_shape.value:
(actor_type = 'user'      and actor_user_id       is not null) or
        (actor_type in ('service','agent') and actor_service_name is not null) or
        (actor_type = 'connector' and actor_connection_id is not null) or
        (actor_type = 'system')

generated.as: case when document_version like 'dpa/%' then 'dpa' else 'baa' end
(((greatest(accepted_at, coalesce(terminated_at, accepted_at)) at time zone 'UTC') + interval '6 years') at time zone 'UTC')

baa_acceptances_termination_reason_check.name: baa_acceptances_termination_reason_check
baa_acceptances_termination_reason_check.value: "baa_acceptances"."termination_reason" is null or ("baa_acceptances"."terminated_at" is not null and "baa_acceptances"."termination_reason" in ('practice_healdesk_breach', 'practice_subcontractor_objection', 'healdesk_practice_breach', 'change_in_law', 'services_ended'))

calendar_elections_kind_consistent.name: calendar_elections_kind_consistent
calendar_elections_kind_consistent.value:
("calendar_elections"."booking_sync" = 'manual' and "calendar_elections"."terms_kind" = 'not_used')
        or ("calendar_elections"."booking_sync" = 'live' and "calendar_elections"."calendar_account" = 'workspace_baa' and "calendar_elections"."terms_kind" = 'covered')
        or ("calendar_elections"."booking_sync" = 'live' and "calendar_elections"."calendar_account" <> 'workspace_baa' and "calendar_elections"."terms_kind" = 'uncovered')

calendar_elections_sent_to_shape.name: calendar_elections_sent_to_shape
calendar_elections_sent_to_shape.value: "calendar_elections"."link_sent_to" is null or "calendar_elections"."link_id" is not null

clinic_settings_greetings_check.name: clinic_settings_greetings_check
clinic_settings_greetings_check.value: ("clinic_settings"."phone_greeting" is null or char_length("clinic_settings"."phone_greeting") between 1 and 300) and ("clinic_settings"."chat_greeting" is null or char_length("clinic_settings"."chat_greeting") between 1 and 300)

clinic_settings_numbers_check.name: clinic_settings_numbers_check
clinic_settings_numbers_check.value: ("clinic_settings"."urgent_help_e164" is null or "clinic_settings"."urgent_help_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$') and ("clinic_settings"."vet_referral_e164" is null or "clinic_settings"."vet_referral_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$') and ("clinic_settings"."transfer_e164" is null or "clinic_settings"."transfer_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')

clinic_settings_history_values_check.name: clinic_settings_history_values_check
clinic_settings_history_values_check.value: ("clinic_settings_history"."before_value" is null or char_length("clinic_settings_history"."before_value") <= 64) and ("clinic_settings_history"."after_value" is null or char_length("clinic_settings_history"."after_value") <= 64)

clinics_dpa_never_hipaa.name: clinics_dpa_never_hipaa
clinics_dpa_never_hipaa.value: "clinics"."agreement_kind" is distinct from 'dpa' or "clinics"."regulatory_regime" is distinct from 'hipaa'

clinics_address_check.name: clinics_address_check
clinics_address_check.value: "clinics"."address" is null or (char_length("clinics"."address") between 1 and 300 and "clinics"."address" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

clinics_website_check.name: clinics_website_check
clinics_website_check.value: "clinics"."website" is null or (char_length("clinics"."website") between 4 and 200 and "clinics"."website" !~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]')

connection_links_calendar_only_flags.name: connection_links_calendar_only_flags
connection_links_calendar_only_flags.value: "connection_links"."purpose" = 'calendar' or ("connection_links"."audience" = 'recipients' and not "connection_links"."allows_account_change" and "connection_links"."pending_election" is null)

entitlements_stripe_mutation_lease_check.name: entitlements_stripe_mutation_lease_check
entitlements_stripe_mutation_lease_check.value: ("entitlements"."stripe_mutation_lease_until" is null) = ("entitlements"."stripe_mutation_lease_owner" is null) and ("entitlements"."stripe_mutation_lease_owner" is null or char_length("entitlements"."stripe_mutation_lease_owner") between 1 and 120)

entitlements_pending_plan_change_check.name: entitlements_pending_plan_change_check
entitlements_pending_plan_change_check.value: ("entitlements"."pending_plan_change_request_id" is null) = ("entitlements"."pending_plan_change_plan_id" is null) and ("entitlements"."pending_plan_change_request_id" is null) = ("entitlements"."pending_plan_change_interval" is null) and ("entitlements"."pending_plan_change_interval" is null or "entitlements"."pending_plan_change_interval" in ('month', 'year')) and ("entitlements"."pending_plan_change_request_id" is null or "entitlements"."pending_plan_change_request_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')

entitlements_pending_location_check.name: entitlements_pending_location_check
entitlements_pending_location_check.value: ("entitlements"."pending_location_request_id" is null) = ("entitlements"."pending_location_count" is null) and ("entitlements"."pending_location_charged_at" is null or "entitlements"."pending_location_request_id" is not null) and ("entitlements"."pending_location_count" is null or "entitlements"."pending_location_count" >= 2) and ("entitlements"."pending_location_request_id" is null or "entitlements"."pending_location_request_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')

google_oauth_states_consumed_ip_check.name: google_oauth_states_consumed_ip_check
google_oauth_states_consumed_ip_check.value: "google_oauth_states"."consumed_ip" is null or "google_oauth_states"."used_at" is not null

provider_connections_alert_needs_break.name: provider_connections_alert_needs_break
provider_connections_alert_needs_break.value: "provider_connections"."broken_alerted_at" is null or "provider_connections"."broken_at" is not null

record_amendments_target_check.name: record_amendments_target_check
record_amendments_target_check.value:
("record_amendments"."target_kind" = 'booking_request' and "record_amendments"."booking_request_id" is not null and "record_amendments"."conversation_id" is null and "record_amendments"."appointment_id" is null)
        or ("record_amendments"."target_kind" = 'conversation' and "record_amendments"."conversation_id" is not null and "record_amendments"."booking_request_id" is null and "record_amendments"."appointment_id" is null)
        or ("record_amendments"."target_kind" = 'appointment' and "record_amendments"."appointment_id" is not null and "record_amendments"."booking_request_id" is null and "record_amendments"."conversation_id" is null)

sign_in_links_redirect_check.name: sign_in_links_redirect_check
sign_in_links_redirect_check.value: "sign_in_links"."redirect_to" is null or ("sign_in_links"."redirect_to" like '/%' and "sign_in_links"."redirect_to" not like '//%' and "sign_in_links"."redirect_to" !~ '[\\[:cntrl:]]')

sign_in_links_consumed_ip_check.name: sign_in_links_consumed_ip_check
sign_in_links_consumed_ip_check.value: "sign_in_links"."consumed_ip" is null or "sign_in_links"."used_at" is not null

slot_holds_held_shape.name: slot_holds_held_shape
slot_holds_held_shape.value:
"slot_holds"."status" <> 'held' or ("slot_holds"."insert_attempted_at" is null and "slot_holds"."blocks_until" is null
        and "slot_holds"."lease_token" is null and "slot_holds"."lease_until" is null and "slot_holds"."next_check_at" is null)

slot_holds_reserved_shape.name: slot_holds_reserved_shape
slot_holds_reserved_shape.value: "slot_holds"."status" <> 'reserved' or ("slot_holds"."blocks_until" is not null and "slot_holds"."insert_attempted_at" is null)

slot_holds_writing_shape.name: slot_holds_writing_shape
slot_holds_writing_shape.value:
"slot_holds"."status" <> 'writing' or ("slot_holds"."lease_token" is not null and "slot_holds"."lease_until" is not null
        and "slot_holds"."insert_attempted_at" is not null and "slot_holds"."blocks_until" is not null)

slot_holds_unknown_shape.name: slot_holds_unknown_shape
slot_holds_unknown_shape.value:
"slot_holds"."status" <> 'unknown' or ("slot_holds"."insert_attempted_at" is not null and "slot_holds"."blocks_until" is not null
        and "slot_holds"."next_check_at" is not null)

transcript_emails_sent_check.name: transcript_emails_sent_check
transcript_emails_sent_check.value: ("transcript_emails"."status" in ('open', 'pending', 'expired')) or ("transcript_emails"."sent_at" is not null and "transcript_emails"."ses_message_id" is not null)

user_factors_passkey_columns.name: user_factors_passkey_columns
user_factors_passkey_columns.value: "user_factors"."kind" <> 'passkey' or ("user_factors"."credential_id" is not null and "user_factors"."public_key" is not null and "user_factors"."counter" is not null and "user_factors"."device_label" is not null and "user_factors"."backed_up" is not null and "user_factors"."secret_sealed" is null and "user_factors"."last_step" is null)

user_factors_totp_columns.name: user_factors_totp_columns
user_factors_totp_columns.value: "user_factors"."kind" <> 'totp' or ("user_factors"."secret_sealed" is not null and "user_factors"."last_step" is not null and "user_factors"."credential_id" is null and "user_factors"."public_key" is null and "user_factors"."counter" is null and "user_factors"."transports" is null and "user_factors"."backed_up" is null)

user_factors_device_label_check.name: user_factors_device_label_check
user_factors_device_label_check.value: "user_factors"."device_label" is null or (char_length("user_factors"."device_label") between 1 and 60 and "user_factors"."device_label" = btrim("user_factors"."device_label") and "user_factors"."device_label" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

webauthn_challenges_basis_check.name: webauthn_challenges_basis_check
webauthn_challenges_basis_check.value: ("webauthn_challenges"."purpose" = 'register') = ("webauthn_challenges"."enrol_basis" is not null) and ("webauthn_challenges"."enrol_basis" is null or "webauthn_challenges"."enrol_basis" in ('first_passkey', 'step_up', 'code'))
